title: Grade 4 SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — Termly Exam #16 (Term 1)

pages.quiz:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #16 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What happens to a dead plant? (1 mark)
   A. It rots and returns nutrients to the soil
   B. It turns into an animal
   C. It becomes a rock
   D. It flies away

2. A sweet potato vine cutting grows roots and becomes a new plant. Which sign of life is shown? (1 mark)
   A. Removing waste
   B. Dying
   C. Breathing out
   D. Reproducing

3. Which of these is a root that we eat? (1 mark)
   A. Carrot
   B. Banana
   C. Maize grain
   D. Cabbage

4. What is the word for the tiny parts in a leaf where air goes in and out? (1 mark)
   A. Petals
   B. Seeds
   C. Roots
   D. Tiny holes

5. A plant with no water for many days will (1 mark)
   A. Grow faster
   B. Make more flowers
   C. Get stronger
   D. Become weak and may die

6. Which group of vertebrates feeds its young on milk? (1 mark)
   A. Mammals
   B. Birds
   C. Fish
   D. Reptiles

7. Which group of animals has dry, scaly skin and includes snakes and crocodiles? (1 mark)
   A. Amphibians
   B. Reptiles
   C. Mammals
   D. Birds

8. What do vertebrates have inside their bodies that invertebrates do not? (1 mark)
   A. Six legs
   B. Feathers
   C. A shell
   D. A backbone

9. Which of these animals lays eggs? (1 mark)
   A. Hen
   B. Goat
   C. Human
   D. Cow

10. Which of these can you use to find out the differences between vertebrates and invertebrates? (1 mark)
   A. Noise
   B. Only guesses
   C. Weather
   D. Books and digital sources

11. Which of these animals has a soft body covered by a hard shell? (1 mark)
   A. Goat
   B. Snail
   C. Hen
   D. Ant

12. Which of these do we drink to keep digestion healthy? (1 mark)
   A. Muddy water
   B. Nothing
   C. Clean safe water
   D. Sugary drinks all the time

13. Which of these can cause stomach ache? (1 mark)
   A. Drinking clean water
   B. Eating too fast or germs in dirty food
   C. Brushing teeth
   D. Washing hands

14. What is the job of the anus? (1 mark)
   A. To make saliva
   B. To let faeces leave the body
   C. To swallow food
   D. To digest food

15. Which of these is a good use of a school deworming day? (1 mark)
   A. Take the tablets when given by the health worker
   B. Give them to animals
   C. Throw them away
   D. Refuse to take them

16. What does the gullet do? (1 mark)
   A. Absorbs food into blood
   B. Makes saliva
   C. Pushes swallowed food to the stomach
   D. Stores faeces

17. A pupil has hard dry faeces. Which is the best advice? (1 mark)
   A. Eat only white bread
   B. Eat more fruits, vegetables and drink water
   C. Eat more sweets
   D. Stop drinking water

18. Which of these describes healthy eating? (1 mark)
   A. Eating fruits, vegetables and whole grains
   B. Never drinking water
   C. Eating only sweets
   D. Eating rotten food

19. Which of these parts is found after the stomach? (1 mark)
   A. Tongue
   B. Small intestine
   C. Gullet
   D. Mouth

20. What can help a child with diarrhoea while waiting to see a health worker? (1 mark)
   A. Drinking clean water and ORS as advised
   B. Eating unwashed fruit
   C. Eating only sweets
   D. Drinking dirty water

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Describe how a pupil can tell that an earthworm is an animal. (3 marks)

22. Describe what happens in the small intestine and why it is important. (4 marks)

23. State three things that plants give to people. (3 marks)

24. List the five groups of vertebrates and give one example of each. (3 marks)

25. Describe an activity to observe the growth of a bean seed. Include what you need, what you do and what you record. (5 marks)

26. Explain what would happen to a young bean plant if all its leaves were removed and why. (4 marks)

27. A bat has wings. Explain why it is not a bird. (3 marks)

28. State three things a child should do when he has diarrhoea. (3 marks)

29. Name the part of a plant that makes food and the part that makes seeds. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #16 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — It rots and returns nutrients to the soil
   Dead plants decay and give nutrients back to the soil.

2. D — Reproducing
   Making a new plant from part of an old plant is reproduction.

3. A — Carrot
   A carrot is a storage root. Cabbage is leaves, banana is a fruit and maize grain is a seed.

4. D — Tiny holes
   Air moves in and out of leaves through tiny holes.

5. D — Become weak and may die
   Water is needed for life, so a plant without it wilts and may die.

6. A — Mammals
   Mammals feed their babies with milk.

7. B — Reptiles
   Reptiles have dry, scaly skin.

8. D — A backbone
   A backbone is the feature that defines vertebrates.

9. A — Hen
   A hen lays eggs. The others give birth to live young.

10. D — Books and digital sources
   We can search print and digital media for information.

11. B — Snail
   A snail has a soft body with a shell on its back.

12. C — Clean safe water
   Clean safe water helps digestion and prevents disease.

13. B — Eating too fast or germs in dirty food
   Fast eating and dirty food can cause stomach pain.

14. B — To let faeces leave the body
   The anus is the opening at the end of the digestive tube.

15. A — Take the tablets when given by the health worker
   Follow the health worker's advice.

16. C — Pushes swallowed food to the stomach
   The gullet squeezes food down.

17. B — Eat more fruits, vegetables and drink water
   Fibre and water help soften faeces.

18. A — Eating fruits, vegetables and whole grains
   Healthy eating includes fibre and a variety of foods.

19. B — Small intestine
   Food moves from the stomach to the small intestine.

20. A — Drinking clean water and ORS as advised
   Water and ORS replace what the body loses.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: It feeds on soil, grows, breathes, moves, responds to touch, reproduces and removes waste. It shows the signs of life.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sign, up to 3.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: Digestion is finished there. Digested food passes through the wall into the blood. The blood carries it to all parts of the body for energy, growth and repair.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point up to 4.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Food, shade, wood, medicine, clean air (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mammals (goat), birds (hen), reptiles (snake), amphibians (frog), fish (tilapia).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for correct five groups, 1 mark for four examples, 1 mark for correct matching.

25. (5 marks)
   Answer: You need a tin or container, soil, a bean seed and water. Plant the seed, water a little each day, measure the shoot with a ruler every two days and record heights in a table. Observe roots and leaves.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for materials, 1 mark for planting, 1 mark for watering, 1 mark for measuring, 1 mark for recording.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: The plant would become weak and stop growing. Leaves make food for the plant. Roots can take in water but without leaves the plant cannot make enough food.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for weak or stops growing, 1 mark for leaves make food, 1 mark for no food made, 1 mark for roots alone are not enough.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: A bat has fur and feeds its young on milk. Birds have feathers and lay eggs. So a bat is a mammal.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fur, 1 mark for milk, 1 mark for mammal.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tell an adult, drink clean water or ORS, and see a health worker. Keep clean.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct action.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Leaves make food and flowers (fruits) make seeds.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct part.
